name: 60E1B900_N3ZBEH
description: 6-port US MT (cal N3ZBEH per RX8Club thread ROM table). Demonstrates adding a new bin.

config._note: TCSR 0xffffec10 / TCNT 0xffffec11 / RSTCSR 0xffffec12 (symbols.tsv). Overflow sets TCSR OVF only; the firmware polls TCSR and calls its service routine (0x31c in 60E15120) itself - 0x31c ends rts and clobbers r0-r4, so it is NOT a raw interrupt entry. IVT vector slot still TODO (E3).
DMAC per symbols.tsv (DMAOR 0xffffecb0, ch0 SAR/DAR/DMATCR/CHCR 0xffffecc0-0xffffeccc). CHCR DE write -> immediate transfer + TE.
PBDR_W 0xfffff738 (offset 0x38) bit15 = external-watchdog heartbeat (service routine 0x31c); PADR 0xfffff726, PDDR 0xfffff746, PEDR 0xfffff754

RCAN HCAN0 block per symbols.tsv (MCR 0xffffe400 ... MD0 0xffffe4b0; mailbox 14 = 0x7e0 RX, 15 = 0x7e8 TX per ref_resetOBDCAN_ 0x109c). W1C pending regs; MCR bit0 <-> GSR bit3 reset handshake; TXPR write transmits (tx_log).
RCAN HCAN1 block (symbols.tsv); not used for OBD diag on 0x7e0/0x7e8

ATU-II per symbols.tsv (TSTR 0xfffff400, ch10 at 0xfffff6c0+, ICR0AH 0xfffff434, DCNT8A-P 0xfffff640-0xfffff65e = injector outputs, channel map ROM 0xd7d4). tick_vector 0x2c8 = CMI10B (IVT table 7.3) -> handler 0x803e; OS tick per ref_setInterruptTimer 0x7778. Crank input capture into ICR0AH/ICR10AH via set_rpm().
SCI0-4 at 0xfffff000-0xfffff027 (symbols.tsv); knock-amplifier command channel per knock report

ADDRnH/L at 0xfffff800+2n (n<=11), ADCSR0/ADCR0 0xfffff818/19, ADDR12+ at 0xfffff820+, ADCSR1/2 0xfffff838/58. Channels per labels: AN3=MAF (0x6884 sweep -> 9eea), AN4/AN5=TP1/TP2 (0x94fc -> 9eec/9eee), AN6=APV (9ef0), AN10=knock (9ef8), AN28=ECT (9f1c), AN29=IAT (9f1e). ADST (ADCR 0x20) -> ADF next tick.

sensors._note: UI/hee sensor inputs wired to the real hardware read paths the firmware uses (E2): via=adc -> ADC ADDRnH channel (raw16 = value*scale); via=atu2 -> crank input capture ICR0AH/ICR10AH (rpm). No more placeholder override registers.
